_note: 2.0.0 (bug-hunt audit K2, from the engine stepTime): the Student Council's canon people by campaign year (engine councilYear; tools/gen_engine.py COUNCIL). year1: the sitting President and Vice President of Year 1 (lore). candidates: the two nominees each year (Year 1 always the owner's two; a later year's pair is set when that year begins and kept once recorded); second_player: in that year the second nominee is {{user}} when {{user}} sits on the Council. skipped: the Year 1 result when a save skipped that election. members: who sits on the Council in that year ($president, $vice: the pair elected the year before; $second: that year's second nominee; {{user}} joins when on the Council); a year not listed uses the last row. Month 12 has no Council. The election's wording is lore (tools/merge_lorebooks.py).
